visualCharacteristics.structure: ingredients list + tools list + numbered steps + step images

contentPattern: 1 row x 2 columns. Cell 1: H3 'Ingredients' + unordered list (quantity + ingredient, product links preserved). Cell 2: H3 'You'll Need' + unordered list of tools; H3 'Directions' + ordered list where each item holds step text (bold quantities) followed by the step image (images inline in list items).
